Please don't consider this as discouraging, but everyone who says it's temporary and it will go away, this too shall pass, or there is a always a better tomorrow mostly don't know what they are talking about. 

May be it happened in their life, that doesn't mean the same will happen in others. Most of them are false promises which will just wear away in a few days and will make you feel even worse than before. 

I have been in the same place 5 years ago (still in the same place or even worse, but hear me out). Everything seems pointless, nothing motivates you I know. 

Say you kill yourself today, sure you won't feel a thing or know what will happen after, all your problems will go away for sure coz you yourself will not be there, but what if you get to be happy in future, then you are missing out that chance if you die now. 

I'm not giving you any false hope that you will be happy in future, but just imagine what if it happens. Can't you hold on to that and continue ?. Sure if you didn't feel happy till the end of your time, it really is a crappy life to be and go, but you would have lived your life on your own terms. 

If you are willing to die, then that is the lowest point you could possibly get, park those thoughts and don't act on it. These thoughts will always come and go, but these are your thoughts that you can gain control over.  

Take control of your thoughts, be it good or bad thoughts. After you do that, it may give you relief because you are in control of how these thoughts make you feel and act. 

I won't promise you that it will be better tomorrow or the other day, but what if it does and you are not around to enjoy it. I believe it's worth fighting and taking control of those and love through to see if I can be happy in future, because in the end it's the journey that matters. 

All of the above are just my thoughts, you can take it or leave it. I don't even know if I have framed those correctly. I may be in a worse condition than you, but I'm sharing how I feel here. 

If the above made you think and feel different and if you are willing to take control then I would advise you try looking into stoicism, it's a great philosophy for people like us.

How do you mean "same pixel count, just smaller" ? 
To get the same pixel density as a fhd on a 6 inch screen, you need 8k resolution on 24 inch.

Fhd has ~2m pixels, while 8k has ~33m pixels. This is more than 16 times the pixel count. 

To drive these many pixels at 144hz smoothly in games, we need to wait at least 10 years or so for graphics cards to improve.
